exposure: Low-dose ketamine (0.5 mg kg-1 IV bolus + 0.25 mg kg-1 h-1 infusion)
cohort: The study included 52 women classified as ASA I-II who were undergoing elective Cesarean section under general anesthesia.
finding: Perioperative low-dose ketamine significantly reduced 24-hour postoperative morphine consumption and lowered pain scores at 15 minutes postoperatively compared to the control group.
